purpose: Observe a new memory attempt after nonempty ACP thought output, preempt through the real foreground path, then recover the same job with a new lease and review its complete shadow response.
scope: Fresh synthetic fixture and a new run directory. Do not rerun the two checkpoint22 jobs or replace their outcomes. This method is not the earlier camera/voice workload and does not claim acoustic, camera, PTZ or 30-minute acceptance.

content.text: Without help, I counted 8 swings in the first 10 seconds and 11 in the second 10 seconds of my pendulum experiment. I kept the string length at 20 cm. I have not yet repeated the runs.

foreground_question: Why do repeated trials help us compare measurements?
required_sequence: Create the fixed source in a fresh simulator learner/activity and finish it before normal production discovery. Keep the voice/foreground learner distinct; do not seed these observations into its context.

Use the production scheduler and real continuous idle gate without changing clocks. Observe job attempt1 and a live active_acp_memory snapshot with matching job_id, attempt_no=1 and fresh request_id/observation_id.

Wait at most 45 seconds for nonempty_thought_event_observed=true with prompt_pending=true. A process-start receipt, local write, metadata update or message-only chunk is insufficient for this branch. If no qualifying event occurs, fail/not-covered and stop; do not add a replacement job or call.

Immediately submit the fixed foreground question via the normal foreground API. Record the timestamp, exact background observation identity, first attempt preemption status, lease release and absence of late committed candidates.

The background transport may read the matching prompt terminal for at most 500 ms after sending session/cancel, before close/kill. Record agent_cancel_terminal_observed separately from local cleanup. end_turn/EOF/timeout/write success are not cancellation acknowledgements.

Finish the one foreground reply without substituting an acknowledgement or retry. Allow the existing scheduler to recover the same background job on attempt2 after the real idle requirement; verify new lease identity, unchanged sources and complete validated shadow candidates.

Review every nonempty memory candidate against 8/11 swings, the two 10-second intervals, the 20 cm condition and the explicit no-repeat report. Empty candidates count as completed invocation but insufficient substantive coverage, with no extra sampling. Review foreground content for cross-learner leakage.

Close the actual owned provider and scheduler; record real process wait/directory cleanup and preserved source versions. Neither local cleanup nor ACP cancelled proves remote compute has physically stopped.
agent_output_claim: A matching nonempty ACP thought event is observed generation output from the agent protocol. It is not direct supplier-compute telemetry or an exact model-token timestamp.
memory_response_acceptance: Only a complete single JSON object after the appropriate prompt terminal, verified no-tools profile and owned cleanup can return. Existing Store source/version/lease/candidate validation remains authoritative. No partial response or cancellation tail may be staged.
notes: This file fixes a future experiment and budgets; it is not an implemented/approved passing harness or evidence of any model call. Application and compilation are root-managed. A separate future unified camera/voice/ACP-memory run remains necessary for that broader scope.
